concerns.text: SC-003 and US-3's Independent Test require a PDF report ('a PDF report, a NIfTI map of significant parcels, and a power analysis section'); plan.md Phase 4 also promises 'Produce PDF report'. No task produces a PDF — T013 writes reports/results_summary.md and T012 produces figures. If PDF generation is a paper-stage handoff, T014's handoff must explicitly name the PDF deliverable; currently neither a task nor the handoff list covers it.

Constitution VI mandates a robustness re-analysis restricted to low-motion participants (mean FD < 0.2 mm). FR-002 already excludes FD ≥ 0.2 mm cohort-wide, so the primary analysis IS the low-motion subset, but no task performs or documents a distinct motion-robustness check (e.g., a stricter FD threshold re-run) to satisfy the constitution's robustness requirement. plan.md's Constitution Check claims this re-run exists.

FR-008 requires sweeping 'tolerance parameter r ... and scale parameter m over a set of discrete magnitudes'; SC-004 requires m ∈ {small, moderate, large}. T011 fixes embedding dimension m=2 and sweeps scale-averaging sets τ instead — the m dimension of the sensitivity analysis is never varied by any task, so FR-008/SC-004 are only partially covered.

Active contracts require fields no task produces: entropy_schema requires metadata.includes_noise_variance (referencing a nonexistent FR-009), resampling_correlation, ks_pvalue; statistical_result_schema requires per-parcel vif and partial_corr_entropy_dsrt. T005/T007/T008 outputs omit these, so tasks will emit schema-invalid outputs. Either add tasks/fields or the contracts are orphan scope needing correction upstream.

data-model.md declares results at results/model_coefficients.csv, results/significant_parcels.nii.gz, reports/link_entropy_risk.pdf, but tasks write data/results/model_coefficients.csv, data/results/significant_map.nii.gz, reports/results_summary.md. No task reconciles the declared data-model paths with the paths actually produced.

Two near-duplicate conflicting schemas exist for the same artifacts (entropy.schema.yaml vs entropy_schema.schema.yaml; stat_results vs statistical_result). T005 cites 'entropy.schema.yaml' and T007 cites 'stat_results.schema.yaml' but the duplicate contracts have different required fields; tasks do not state which contract governs, leaving conformance ambiguous.
